name: TU Berlin — official website

extractionHints.detail: Study-course pages have a 'Basic information' table (period of study, credit points, admission type, language). The dates-deadlines page has separate application windows per semester/admission-type that must be matched to the specific program's admission type.

notes: robots.txt sets Content-Signal: ai-train=no, ai-input=no, search=yes and otherwise Allow: / — this crawl is for building a cited, source-linked factual catalog (equivalent in spirit to search indexing), not model training/input, and every fact loaded from it retains its sourceUrl for direct attribution. Seed URLs confirmed real and reachable (2026-08-10); the /en/study/degree-programs/* path guessed during planning was a 404 and has been replaced with the real /en/studying/study-programs/all-programs-offered/study-course/* path discovered via the site's own navigation.
